description: Tool to append values to a spreadsheet. Use when you need to add new data to the end of an existing table in a Google Sheet.

range.title: Range
range.description: A1 notation range used to locate a logical table. New rows are appended after the last row of that table within this range. First call GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SHEET_NAMES with this exact spreadsheet_id and use one of the returned sheet names; sheet names are case-sensitive and default names like 'Sheet1' are unsafe guesses. Valid formats: exact sheet name only (e.g., 'Sales Data'), sheet-qualified column range (e.g., 'Sales Data!A:D'), or sheet-qualified cell range (e.g., 'Sales Data!A1:D100'). Do not pass bare ranges like 'A:F' or 'A1:D100' because they omit the sheet name. If the needed sheet is not returned, create it or ask the user instead of inventing a name. Sheet names with spaces need single quotes (auto-added). IMPORTANT: The append may land in different columns than specified due to API table detection. For strict column placement, use GOOGLESHEETS_SPREADSHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE instead. Always check updates.updatedRange in the response to verify where data was actually written.
range.human_parameter_description: Call GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SHEET_NAMES first, then use an exact returned sheet name in formats like 'Sales Data!A:D' or 'Sales Data!A1:D100'. Do not use bare ranges like 'A:F' or guessed default names like 'Sheet1' unless returned by that action. WARNING: The API may append to different columns than specified due to table detection logic. Always check the response to verify where data was written.

values.title: Values
values.description: 2D array of values to append. Typically, each inner list is a ROW (majorDimension=ROWS). Use null/None for empty cells.
values.human_parameter_description: Provide the data you want to append as a list of lists where each inner list represents a row.

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheetId.description: The spreadsheet ID (typically 44 characters containing letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores). Found in the URL between /d/ and /edit. NOT the sheet name (tab name) - that belongs in the 'range' parameter.
spreadsheetId.human_parameter_description: Provide the unique identifier of the spreadsheet from its URL (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'). This is NOT the sheet name - use the 'range' parameter for sheet names.

majorDimension.title: Major Dimension
majorDimension.description: How to interpret the 2D values array. Use ROWS for row-wise data (most common for appends). Use COLUMNS for column-wise data. Example: if A1=1,B1=2,A2=3,B2=4 then majorDimension=ROWS yields [[1,2],[3,4]] and majorDimension=COLUMNS yields [[1,3],[2,4]].
majorDimension.human_parameter_description: Indicate if your data is organized in rows or columns.

insertDataOption.title: Insert Data Option
insertDataOption.description: How the input data should be inserted.
insertDataOption.human_parameter_description: Select whether to overwrite existing data or insert rows for the new data.

valueInputOption.title: Value Input Option
valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted.
valueInputOption.human_parameter_description: Choose how the data you provide should be interpreted—raw or as user-entered values.

includeValuesInResponse.title: Include Values In Response
includeValuesInResponse.description: Determines if the update response should include the values of the cells that were appended. By default, responses do not include the updated values.
includeValuesInResponse.human_parameter_description: Decide if you want the response to include the values that were just added.

responseValueRenderOption.title: Response Value Render Option
responseValueRenderOption.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. The default render option is FORMATTED_VALUE.
responseValueRenderOption.human_parameter_description: Choose how you want the values in the response to be displayed.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.title: Response Date Time Render Option
responseDateTimeRenderOption.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. This is ignored if responseValueRenderOption is FORMATTED_VALUE. The default dateTime render option is SERIAL_NUMBER.
responseDateTimeRenderOption.human_parameter_description: Select how you want dates and times in the response to be formatted.

updatedData.title: Updated Data
updatedData.description: The values after the update. Present only if includeValuesInResponse=true. Values are rendered according to responseValueRenderOption and responseDateTimeRenderOption if provided.

updatedRows.title: Updated Rows
updatedRows.description: The number of rows in the updated range that changed (rows where at least one cell was updated). May be omitted if not returned by the API.

updatedCells.title: Updated Cells
updatedCells.description: The total number of cells updated. May be omitted if not returned by the API.

updatedRange.title: Updated Range
updatedRange.description: The A1-notation of the range that was updated (e.g., 'Sheet1!A11:D11').

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet where the update occurred (typically the same as the top-level spreadsheetId).

updatedColumns.title: Updated Columns
updatedColumns.description: The number of columns in the updated range that changed (columns where at least one cell was updated). May be omitted if not returned by the API.

UpdatedDataValueRange.title: UpdatedDataValueRange

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1-notation range that the returned values cover.

values.title: Values
values.description: The values in the range. The outer array corresponds to majorDimension; each inner array contains cell values. In responses, trailing empty rows or columns are omitted. Cell values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or null depending on render options. This field may be omitted when no data is appended (e.g., when appending empty values).

majorDimension.title: Major Dimension
majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. ROWS means each inner array represents a row; COLUMNS means each inner array represents a column.

UpdatedDataValueRange.description:
Response ValueRange for updatedData in UpdateValuesResponse.
Separate from request ValueRange to enforce required fields per API docs:
range and majorDimension are required when returned; values may be omitted when no data is appended.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Information about the updates that were applied (UpdateValuesResponse).

tableRange.title: Table Range
tableRange.description: The A1-notation range of the table that values were appended to (before the append), for example 'Sheet1!A1:D10'. Empty if no table was found. This field may be omitted if no table range is detected.

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to which values were appended.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
